newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila TV station sale attracts 34 firms.
newsitem.headline: Manila TV station sale attracts 34 firms.

text.p: The Philippines' Presidential Commission on Good Government (PCGG) said on Monday 34 companies had expressed interest in acquiring the television station, Intercontinental Broadcasting Corp (IBC) or Channel 13.
JG Summit Holdings Inc and leading local film company Regal Films Inc were among the 34 companies which attended the pre-bidding conference last Friday.
PCGG has set the floor price at 2 billion pesos. The bidding is scheduled on December 27.
The PCGG is an agency in charge of tracking down the assets of the late dictator Ferdinand Marcos, who was deposed from 20 years of rule in a popular revolt 10 years ago.
Channel 13 was owned by a Marcos associate until the PCGG sequestered its shares.
JG Summit is a holding company with interests in food, telecommunications, banking and real estate.
